title: Aye Mere Bhai Raza
body:
Aye Mere Bhai Raza
<<DIVIDER>>
Assalamo alaika ya ghareebal ghuraba
ya moinaz zo'afaye wal fuqara
As sultan Arab E wal ajam
Mola ALI ibna MUSA RAZA.
<<MINI>>
Aye Mere Bhai Raza
<<DIVIDER>>
Aye Ghareeb ul Ghurba
Roke MAASOOMA E QUM
Qum se deti hain sada
<<MINI>>
Aye Mere Bhai Raza
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Tera deedar nahi Bhai qismat me meri
De hawaon ko Zara hukm aye mere ALI
Sun lun awaaz teri..(2)
dil behel jaye mera
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Dekhne aayi hu mai qum me Surat teri
Aye ghareebul ghuraba dekh ghurbat meri
Koyi batlata nahi..(2)
mujhko mashhad ka pata
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Mujhpe Jo beet gaye wo alam kuch bhi nahi
Saamne ZAINAB ke mere ghum kuch bhi nahi
Mai na bazaaar gayi..(2)
na chini meri rida
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Jabse pahonchi hun mai qum dil hai qabu me kaha'n
Gham zada aaye nazar shehr k peer O jawa'n
Dekh kar kaale alam..(2)
dil dehelta hai mera
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Hu yateema lekin wo yateema to nahi
Qaidi Baba KI qasam mai SAKINA to nahi
Jiske gohar bhi chine..(2)
haye jiska daaman bhi jala
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Kis jagah khaar chubhe kis jagah thak ke giri
Poocho chalo se Zara kaise Meelo mai chali
Zakhm pairo ke tumhe..(2)
gham sunayenge mera
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Sath jayega mere ye gham e tanhayi
Tum bhi AKBAR KI tarha nahi laute Bhai
Roz SUGHRA ki tarha mai jalati hun diya
8. Qum se mashhad Jo gaya zaair e MOLA RAZA
<<DIVIDER>>
Ay takallum wo yahi leke paigham chala
Rasta Teri behen..(2)
ab bhi takti hai tera
